
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/swizard/p/19422166" title="发布于 2025-12-30 16:43">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">“这行命令跑了一晚，日志全丢了？”—— 5分钟彻底搞懂 Linux I/O 重定向与 tee 大法</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-path-to-node="4">1. 引言：午夜心碎时刻</h2>
<p data-path-to-node="5">你有没有经历过这样的场景：</p>
<p data-path-to-node="6">临下班前，你写好了一个数据迁移脚本，在终端敲下命令，看着进度条开始跑，心满意足地回家了。 第二天一早，你满怀期待地打开电脑，发现终端窗口因为网络波动断开了（Broken Pipe），或者被系统的自动更新重启了。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="7"><strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="0">结果：</strong> 屏幕上的日志没了，文件里也没存。脚本到底跑完了吗？报错了吗？在哪断的？ <strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="40">答案：</strong> 上帝才知道。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="8">这就是**“数据流失”**的惨痛教训。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="9">今天要讲的 <code data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="6">&gt;</code>、<code data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="8">&gt;&gt;</code>、<code data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="11">&amp;</code> 和 <code data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="15">tee</code>，就是 Linux 世界里的<strong data-path-to-node="9" data-index-in-node="32">管道工工具包</strong>。学会它们，你就能随心所欲地控制程序输出的去向——既能在屏幕上看“现场直播”，又能把日志存进文件“录像回放”。</p>
<hr data-path-to-node="10">
<h2 data-path-to-node="11">2. 概念拆解：Linux 的水管系统</h2>
<p data-path-to-node="12">在 Linux 的哲学里，<strong data-path-to-node="12" data-index-in-node="13">“一切皆文件”</strong>。程序的输入输出，本质上就是三根水管。</p>
<h3 data-path-to-node="13">核心三要素</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="14">我们把一个运行的程序想象成一台<strong data-path-to-node="14" data-index-in-node="15">净水器</strong>：</p>
<ol start="1" data-path-to-node="15">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="15,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="15,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">标准输入 (stdin, 0)</strong>：进水管。通常是键盘输入，或者别的文件传进来的数据。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="15,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="15,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">标准输出 (stdout, 1)</strong>：出水管（净水）。程序正常运行产生的打印信息，默认流向你的<strong data-path-to-node="15,1,0" data-index-in-node="45">显示器</strong>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="15,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="15,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">标准错误 (stderr, 2)</strong>：排污管（废水）。程序报错时的警告或错误信息，默认也流向你的<strong data-path-to-node="15,2,0" data-index-in-node="46">显示器</strong>。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 data-path-to-node="16">符号图解</h3>
<ul data-path-to-node="17">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="17,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,0,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="17,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">&gt;</code> (覆盖重定向)</strong>： 相当于把出水管从显示器上拔下来，插到一个桶（文件）里。 <em data-path-to-node="17,0,0" data-index-in-node="39">注意：每次都会先把桶倒空，再接水。</em></p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="17,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,1,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="17,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">&gt;&gt;</code> (追加重定向)</strong>： 也把出水管插到桶里。 <em data-path-to-node="17,1,0" data-index-in-node="23">区别：如果桶里原本有水，它不倒掉，直接接着往里灌。</em></p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="17,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,2,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="17,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">|</code> (管道)</strong>： 把前一台净水器的出水管，直接接到下一台净水器的进水管。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="17,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="17,3,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="17,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">tee</code> (T型三通管)</strong>： 这就是神奇的神器。它是一个<strong data-path-to-node="17,3,0" data-index-in-node="26">T型接头</strong>。水流过来，一份流向屏幕（让你看），一份分流进文件（存盘）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr data-path-to-node="18">
<h2 data-path-to-node="19">3. 动手实战：从青铜到王者</h2>
<p data-path-to-node="20">我们先创建一个极简的脚本 <code data-path-to-node="20" data-index-in-node="13">demo.sh</code> 来模拟真实场景。这个脚本会同时产生“正常日志”和“错误报错”。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-161 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQpAM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-161 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-161">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-161 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-161">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-161">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-161 highlighter-hljs"><code># demo.sh
# 模拟正常输出 (stdout)
echo "✅ [INFO] 处理数据块 1..."
echo "✅ [INFO] 处理数据块 2..."

# 模拟报错 (stderr) - 注意这里我们强制输出到 stderr
echo "❌ [ERROR] 连接数据库失败！" &gt;&amp;2

echo "✅ [INFO] 任务结束。"</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h3 data-path-to-node="22">场景一：初级——直接存文件 (<code data-path-to-node="22" data-index-in-node="15">&gt;</code>)</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="23">你只想把结果存起来，不关心屏幕看没看见。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-162 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQpQM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-162 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-162">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-162 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-162">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-162">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-162 highlighter-hljs"><code>bash demo.sh &gt; result.log</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<ul data-path-to-node="25">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="25,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="25,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">结果</strong>：</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="25,0,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="25,0,1,0,0"><code data-path-to-node="25,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">result.log</code> 里只有 <code data-path-to-node="25,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="15">✅ [INFO]...</code>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="25,0,1,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="25,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">等等！</strong> 屏幕上居然打印了 <code data-path-to-node="25,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="13">❌ [ERROR]...</code>？</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="25,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="25,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">为什么？</strong></p>
<ul data-path-to-node="25,1,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="25,1,1,0,0">因为 <code data-path-to-node="25,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="3">&gt;</code> 默认只接管了 <strong data-path-to-node="25,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="12">1号水管 (stdout)</strong>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="25,1,1,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="25,1,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">2号水管 (stderr)</strong> 依然指向屏幕，所以报错漏出来了，没存进文件里！</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-path-to-node="26">场景二：进阶——全量保存 (<code data-path-to-node="26" data-index-in-node="14">2&gt;&amp;1</code>)</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="27">这是新手最头疼的符号。我们想把“报错”和“正常日志”都存进同一个文件。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-163 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQpgM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-163 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-163">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-163 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-163">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-163">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-163 highlighter-hljs"><code>bash demo.sh &gt; result.log 2&gt;&amp;1</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<ul data-path-to-node="29">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="29,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="29,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">代码解析</strong>：</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="29,0,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="29,0,1,0,0"><code data-path-to-node="29,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">&gt; result.log</code>：先把 1号管 接到文件。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="29,0,1,1,0"><code data-path-to-node="29,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">2&gt;&amp;1</code>：这是一个“并管”操作。意思是：<strong data-path-to-node="29,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="20">把 2号管 (stderr) 的出口，汇入到 1号管 (stdout) 当前的流向中。</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="29,0,1,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="29,0,1,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">结果</strong>：正常日志和报错都乖乖进了 <code data-path-to-node="29,0,1,2,0" data-index-in-node="16">result.log</code>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-path-to-node="30">场景三：王者——我全都要 (<code data-path-to-node="30" data-index-in-node="14">tee</code>)</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="31">这就是解决引言中痛点的终极方案。既要在屏幕上监控进度，又要存文件备份。</p>
<div class="attachment-container search-images">
<div class="image-container ng-star-inserted" data-full-size-image-uri="https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/licensed-image?q=tbn:ANd9GcSXutIDMUsVHJb8Xkg0eIBETzOAtyTLr5mBy9DSzQpcjTEIhWBcYRdbe7SNxf9WnlHSoGtsheJMgZMNmwy-Kuco_O2F2DOZPa3oP0Gw0ZP37M1QtYw">
<div class="overlay-container ng-star-inserted"><button class="image-button ng-star-inserted"><img src="https://encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com/licensed-image?q=tbn:ANd9GcSXutIDMUsVHJb8Xkg0eIBETzOAtyTLr5mBy9DSzQpcjTEIhWBcYRdbe7SNxf9WnlHSoGtsheJMgZMNmwy-Kuco_O2F2DOZPa3oP0Gw0ZP37M1QtYw" alt="Image of plumbing tee fitting" class="licensed-image loaded" height="507" width="760"></button>
<div class="licensed-image-source ng-star-inserted"><span class="label ellipsis gds-label-m-alt">Getty Images</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-path-to-node="33">我们需要一个 T型三通（Tee）。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-164 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQqAM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-164 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-164">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-164 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-164">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-164">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-164 highlighter-hljs"><code>bash demo.sh | tee result.log</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<ul data-path-to-node="35">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="35,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="35,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">发生了什么？</strong></p>
<ul data-path-to-node="35,0,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="35,0,1,0,0"><code data-path-to-node="35,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">|</code>：管道符，把 <code data-path-to-node="35,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="8">demo.sh</code> 的输出传给 <code data-path-to-node="35,0,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="22">tee</code> 命令。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="35,0,1,1,0"><code data-path-to-node="35,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">tee</code>：接收到数据后，<strong data-path-to-node="35,0,1,1,0" data-index-in-node="11">左手画圆（打印到屏幕），右手画方（写入 result.log）</strong>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="35,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="35,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">注意</strong>：<code data-path-to-node="35,1,0" data-index-in-node="3">tee</code> 默认只接收 stdout。如果也要保存报错，需要先合并流：</p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-165 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQqQM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-165 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-165">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-165 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-165">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-165">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-165 highlighter-hljs"><code># 完美方案：标准输出+错误，既看屏幕，又存文件
bash demo.sh 2&gt;&amp;1 | tee result.log</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h3 data-path-to-node="37">场景四：不讲武德——追加模式 (<code data-path-to-node="37" data-index-in-node="16">tee -a</code> &amp; <code data-path-to-node="37" data-index-in-node="25">&gt;&gt;</code>)</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="38">如果你不想覆盖昨天的日志，而是想接着写：</p>
<ul data-path-to-node="39">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="39,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="39,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">普通重定向</strong>：用 <code data-path-to-node="39,0,0" data-index-in-node="8">&gt;&gt;</code> 代替 <code data-path-to-node="39,0,0" data-index-in-node="14">&gt;</code>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="39,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="39,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Tee 模式</strong>：用 <code data-path-to-node="39,1,0" data-index-in-node="9">-a</code> (append) 参数。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-166 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQqgM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-166 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-166">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-166 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-166">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-166">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-166 highlighter-hljs"><code>bash demo.sh 2&gt;&amp;1 | tee -a result.log</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-path-to-node="41">
<h2 data-path-to-node="42">4. 进阶深潜：那些你不知道的坑</h2>
<h3 data-path-to-node="43">坑 1：<code data-path-to-node="43" data-index-in-node="4">sudo</code> 也不好使？</h3>
<p data-path-to-node="44">你可能遇到过这种情况：想把一段文本写入一个只有 root 权限才能写的文件（比如 <code data-path-to-node="44" data-index-in-node="41">/etc/profile</code>）。</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-167 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQqwM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-167 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-167">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-167 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-167">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-167">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-167 highlighter-hljs"><code># ❌ 错误示范
sudo echo "export JAVA_HOME=..." &gt;&gt; /etc/profile
# 报错: Permission denied</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-path-to-node="46"><strong data-path-to-node="46" data-index-in-node="0">为什么？</strong> 因为 <code data-path-to-node="46" data-index-in-node="8">sudo</code> 只对 <code data-path-to-node="46" data-index-in-node="16">echo</code> 命令生效。后面的 <code data-path-to-node="46" data-index-in-node="30">&gt;&gt;</code> 是由你当前的 Shell 执行的，而你的 Shell 没有权限写 <code data-path-to-node="46" data-index-in-node="66">/etc/profile</code>。</p>
<p data-path-to-node="47"><strong data-path-to-node="47" data-index-in-node="0">✅ 最佳实践 (使用 tee)</strong>：</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-168 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQrAM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-168 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-168">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-168 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-168">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-168">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-168 highlighter-hljs"><code>echo "export JAVA_HOME=..." | sudo tee -a /etc/profile</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-path-to-node="49">这里 <code data-path-to-node="49" data-index-in-node="3">sudo</code> 提升了 <code data-path-to-node="49" data-index-in-node="12">tee</code> 的权限，<code data-path-to-node="49" data-index-in-node="20">tee</code> 负责写文件，完美解决。为了不让屏幕多打印一遍，可以扔进黑洞：</p>
<div class="code-block ng-tns-c3098535048-169 ng-animate-disabled ng-trigger ng-trigger-codeBlockRevealAnimation" data-hveid="0" data-ved="0CAAQhtANahgKEwi3u9661eSRAxUAAAAAHQAAAAAQrQM">
<div class="code-block-decoration header-formatted gds-title-s ng-tns-c3098535048-169 ng-star-inserted"><span class="ng-tns-c3098535048-169">Bash</span>
<div class="buttons ng-tns-c3098535048-169 ng-star-inserted">&nbsp;</div>
</div>
<div class="formatted-code-block-internal-container ng-tns-c3098535048-169">
<div class="animated-opacity ng-tns-c3098535048-169">
<pre class="ng-tns-c3098535048-169 highlighter-hljs"><code>echo "data" | sudo tee file.txt &gt; /dev/null</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h3 data-path-to-node="51">坑 2：<code data-path-to-node="51" data-index-in-node="4">2&gt;&amp;1 &gt; file</code> vs <code data-path-to-node="51" data-index-in-node="19">&gt; file 2&gt;&amp;1</code></h3>
<p data-path-to-node="52">这两个命令看起来很像，但效果完全不同！<strong data-path-to-node="52" data-index-in-node="19">顺序非常重要！</strong></p>
<ol start="1" data-path-to-node="53">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="53,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="53,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">正确：</strong> <code data-path-to-node="53,0,0" data-index-in-node="4">&gt; file 2&gt;&amp;1</code></p>
<ul data-path-to-node="53,0,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="53,0,1,0,0">解释：先把 1 指向文件，然后把 2 指向 1（也就是文件）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="53,0,1,1,0">结果：大家都在文件里。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="53,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="53,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">错误：</strong> <code data-path-to-node="53,1,0" data-index-in-node="4">2&gt;&amp;1 &gt; file</code></p>
<ul data-path-to-node="53,1,1">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="53,1,1,0,0">解释：先把 2 指向 1（此时 1 还在屏幕），所以 2 去了屏幕。<strong data-path-to-node="53,1,1,0,0" data-index-in-node="34">然后</strong>把 1 指向文件。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="53,1,1,1,0">结果：报错打在了屏幕上，只有正常日志进了文件。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<hr data-path-to-node="54">
<h2 data-path-to-node="55">5. 总结与延伸</h2>
<h3 data-path-to-node="56">一句话总结</h3>
<ul data-path-to-node="57">
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="57,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="57,0,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="57,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">&gt;</code></strong> 是“洗心革面”（覆盖文件）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="57,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="57,1,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="57,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">&gt;&gt;</code></strong> 是“再续前缘”（追加文件）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="57,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="57,2,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="57,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">2&gt;&amp;1</code></strong> 是“兄弟齐心”（错误流汇入标准流）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p data-path-to-node="57,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="57,3,0" data-index-in-node="0"><code data-path-to-node="57,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">tee</code></strong> 是“分身有术”（屏幕和文件我都要）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
